scope: Independent source review; no live capture/provider/data mutation. Parent independently runs tests.

findings.mechanics: Proof contains policyBinding and sources only, with no active callId or per-HTTP nonce/input hash. Verification accepts any exact previously signed response in the same policy. Actual raw HTTP observer adds the currently active callId after verification. Distinct calls A/B both pass final unique-call census if the same signed body is delivered as both HTTP responses.
findings.threatBoundary: Requires substitution/replay at the raw trusted HTTP response boundary. Model/citation/caller result JSON alone does not enter the WeakMap or mint tenant authority. Not a demonstrated remote attacker path.
findings.requiredRepair: Bind the actual invocation/request identity into a trusted request transport, include it in API proof signature, and compare it to the active HTTP invocation on receive; include same-policy distinct-call replay tests.

passingEvidence: CanonicalTenantId originates from mi.tenant_id selected in SQL and memoryRecord(row); client originates row.clientId. No missing row tenant fallback to request exists.
HMAC verified against recomputed sources; full page hash binds text and source version; wrong policy/tenant/version/text fail closed.
Raw response storage precedes model projection, uses policy WeakMap and requires actual pending invocation/attempt; readout requires returned one-attempt HTTP200.
Source join checks citation id/kind/record/version/client/snippet hash. Partial pages are fullRead false and full byte hash UNKNOWN.
Final semantic clock join rejects duplicate call identities and failed/multiattempt/non200 invocations, but cannot distinguish two distinct call IDs relabeled over one same-policy signed body.
otherNotes: Some nonfatal malformed values may pass intermediate JS coercions, but they cannot create a valid unknown HMAC or bypass tenant/client string comparisons. Explicit type checks are optional hardening.
Nullable canonical client intentionally stays UNKNOWN and receipt remains blocked; no policy owner inference.
All-record signing rejects any unavailable/empty/missing-owner row; operational behavior is fail closed and may reduce successful coverage; not a trust bypass.
